# Tommy 3.1.2

`Tommy.dll` is the unmodified `lib/net35/Tommy.dll` from the official
[Tommy 3.1.2 NuGet package](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Tommy/3.1.2),
[source repository](https://github.com/dezhidki/Tommy).

SHA-256: `2684b7eaaca463ddb08e8bf55f12b0d8bf0b02ee868cf6a7b0d3c42b4b53003d`.

License: [MIT](Tommy.LICENSE). This dependency is loaded only for configuration
validation and editing. Installation works offline; no package restore occurs
on the user's machine. The .NET 3.5 build works on Windows PowerShell 5.1 and
PowerShell 7 without additional runtime dependencies.
